_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
Nyoka ya vatshani {num_players} kwenye bredeni ya {width}×{height}.
U na kongomelo ya nyoka {player_id}. Mizungu leyi amukelekile: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (kumbe w/s/a/d).
Ntirho: pona nkarhi wo leha kapa u va na kuleha u kuma ntsengo wo antswa (mpaka wa mizungu {max_turns} mizungu).

game_action.invalid_death: Nyoka {player_id} yi file hikwalaho ka ku va a nga fambanga kahle.

outcome.survived_win: Mutlangi {player_id} u ponile; lavan'wana hinkwavo va file.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Tinyoka hinkwato ti fe hi nkarhi wun'we.
outcome.outlived: Mutlangi u fe ku tlula lavan'wana hinkwavo.
outcome.turn_limit: Loko ku fikeleriwe mpimo wa ndzhendzheleko - loyi a nga ni timaraka to tala u hlula eka tie-break.
